summary: Iteration 11 testing: Verified two new improvements - (1) spectator seat positioning using SEAT_TO_ANGLE mapping and (2) preferred seat selection via POST /api/tables/join. All 10 backend API tests and all 11 frontend UI tests PASS.

issues: Seat labels show 1-based numbering (SEAT 2 through SEAT 6 for seats 1-5) while data-testid uses 0-based (take-seat-1 through take-seat-5). This is intentional for UX but worth noting.

lobby_view_table_button.detail: Lobby shows '👁 View Table' for users NOT in table, '↩ Return to Table' (cyan) for users already in table. Navigating via View Table enters spectator mode without calling join API.

spectating_badge.detail: SPECTATING badge (👁 SPECTATING) visible in top bar when user visits table without joining.

spectator_empty_seat_buttons.detail: Empty seats shown as labeled dashed circle buttons with data-testid='take-seat-0' through 'take-seat-5'. Labels show 'SEAT N+1' (1-based: SEAT 2, SEAT 3, etc.). AceKing at seat 0 (top) leaves 5 empty seat buttons visible.

spectator_player_positions.detail: Players rendered via players.map() using SEAT_TO_ANGLE: seat 0=-90° (top), 1=-45° (upper-right), 2=0° (right), 3=90° (bottom), 4=135° (lower-left), 5=-135° (left). AceKing at seat 0 correctly appears at TOP of oval.

preferred_seat_4.detail: POST /api/tables/join with preferred_seat=4 returns {seat: 4}. Backend assigns exactly the requested seat.

preferred_seat_taken_400.detail: POST /api/tables/join with preferred_seat=4 when seat 4 already taken returns 400 with 'Seat already taken'.

preferred_seat_invalid_99.detail: POST /api/tables/join with preferred_seat=99 returns 400 'Invalid seat number'.

preferred_seat_auto_assign.detail: POST /api/tables/join without preferred_seat auto-assigns first available seat (seat 0 on empty table).

full_6_6_table_spectator.detail: Full 6/6 table with all 6 players at seats 0-5 confirmed. Spectator view shows all 6 players at their ACTUAL positions using SEAT_TO_ANGLE. No empty seat buttons shown. 6th player (HighRoller at seat 5, left side -135°) correctly visible - old bug with only 5 visible is fixed.

spectator_click_specific_seat.detail: Clicking take-seat-4 button calls handleTakeSeat(4) which sends preferred_seat=4 to backend. CardShark joined at seat 4 confirmed via API.

spectator_to_player_transition.detail: After clicking seat button, SPECTATING badge disappears and user transitions to player view. CardShark appears in the players list.

critical_code_review_comments: PokerTable.tsx opponents array (line 584) still uses old 5-slot approach for non-spectator view: opponents = SEAT_ANGLES.map((_, i) => opps[i] ?? null). This is correct and unchanged - SEAT_TO_ANGLE is only used for spectator view as specified.
handleTakeSeat properly passes preferredSeat as body.preferred_seat only when defined (line 529-531).
Empty seat filter logic: Array.from({length: gameState.max_players}, (_, s) => s).filter(s => !players.some(p => p.seat === s)) correctly shows only unoccupied seats.
The spectator hint 'Click a seat above to join' only shows when players.length < max_players - correct behavior.
seed_data_creation: Test tables ST5B7Z and PY3NT9 created during testing, both cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features from iter 10 + iter 11 are working. Web app is at /app/web/src/ (NOT /app/frontend/). Auth uses data-testid='profile-{lowercase_username}' and data-testid='pin-btn-{n}'. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/. Key selectors: data-testid='take-seat-{0-5}' for spectator empty seats, data-testid='table-btn-{table_id}' for lobby table buttons. SEAT_TO_ANGLE = {0:-90, 1:-45, 2:0, 3:90, 4:135, 5:-135}. Spectator view uses players.map() not opponent array.

rca_of_improvements.full_table_fix: Old code used 5-slot opponents array (SEAT_ANGLES.map((_, i) => opps[i])) which would miss the 6th player in spectator view. New code uses players.map() with SEAT_TO_ANGLE lookup, rendering ALL players at their actual seat positions.
rca_of_improvements.preferred_seat_selection: New JoinTableReq.preferred_seat Optional[int] field + validation logic (lines 847-852 in server.py): returns 400 for out-of-range seats or already-taken seats. Frontend handleTakeSeat(preferredSeat?) passes the seat number when available. Empty seat buttons use data-testid='take-seat-{s}' and call handleTakeSeat(s).
